nodes.content: Ross speaks to an unseen person, saying, 'We know you took so just-just save yourself the time and confess!'

Joey is standing behind Ross, looking at him with a concerned expression.
Chandler is standing on the left, looking at Ross.
The scene takes place indoors, in what appears to be a hallway or apartment entrance.

edges.reason: person_1 provides the visual of Joey's concerned reaction, while person_2 provides the visual of Chandler's reaction, jointly showing the reactions of the group to Ross's statement.
